instructions.title: How to use
instructions.step_1_a: Navigate to the "Bulk List Cards" and filter by the set you want to upload cards from.
instructions.step_2: Press the "Import CSV..." button injected by this extension. It should be right below the "Bulk Modification" menu.
instructions.step_3: Select your file and match the columns in the CSV to the columns in Cardmarket.
instructions.step_4: Press "SELECT ROWS" and select which rows to fill from the CSV (up to 100).
instructions.step_5: Press "FILL PAGE!". The extension will automatically fill in the table with the selected rows!

editionDashboard.title: Editions in your CSV
editionDashboard.openAll: Open all editions in new tabs
editionDashboard.foilsExplain: These cards are marked as foil in your CSV. Cardmarket usually has a single product page that handles both foil and non-foil — the extension will tick the Foil checkbox automatically. However, some special promos exist as separate Cardmarket products (Showcase, Borderless, Extended Art, etc.) and may not be matched by name alone. Verify these manually after auto-fill.
editionDashboard.fillPageHint: Fills the current edition with these cards in one click.
editionDashboard.fillPagePartialHint: Some cards are not visible on the current Cardmarket page.
editionDashboard.fillPageInvisibleWarning: card(s) belong to this edition but are not visible in the Cardmarket table — change page or filter on Cardmarket to make them appear.
editionDashboard.fillPageRowInvisibleTooltip: This card belongs to the current edition but is not visible in the Cardmarket table. Change page or filter to make it appear.
editionDashboard.fillPageEmpty: No card from your CSV matches the current Cardmarket edition.
editionDashboard.unmatchedExplain: These cards could not be matched to a known Cardmarket edition (special promos, very old sets, etc.). Find the right edition on Cardmarket and use 'Import CSV...' manually from there.
